evidence_objects_collection.scope: accepted evidence objects for GLD in the declared corpus
evidence_objects_collection.ordering: available_as_of DESC, accession_number DESC, source_hash DESC
evidence_objects_collection.note: PREVIEW: a capped newest-first slice; total_available counts objects in scope; an as-of query over this slice is INCOMPLETE unless returned == total_available

as_of_recipe: evidence_objects here is a PREVIEW (newest 1 of 1 accepted objects; see evidence_objects_collection). Reconstruct evidence as of D ONLY from the complete history file at history_url (same build_id; verify its sha256 in history_manifest_url): objects with available_as_of <= D (the recorded availability, never filing_date or generated timestamps). From this preview alone the result is INCOMPLETE for every D unless returned == total_available. D before collection.corpus_start or after corpus_end is OUT_OF_RANGE. Classification at D = label_history entry for the last date <= D; older dates: yuclaw replay GLD --date D
verify: each object's source_hash is a SHA-256 anchored via the daily ledger root — see /evidence/verify.json
not_advice: Research and education only — not investment advice. Signal labels are research classifications, not buy/sell recommendations. Investment implication: none established — no buy, sell, or alpha conclusion is supported by this object.
